basic_info.description: Noe Valley spacious flat with incredible attention to detail. This completely reconstructed and rebuilt 3 bedroom, 2.5 bathroom, flat sits on the corner of Dolores and 29th Street. The home features ample sunlight, views, and 1 car parking (with the space to add a second). Detached on 3 sides this condominium features an extremely high level of soundproofing from both the street and neighbors below/above. The modern floor plan separates the entertaining space from the living space. At the rear of the home we have a large primary suite with dual closets, a spa like shower, double vanity, and deep soaking tub. Private deck off primary bedroom with room for seating overlooking private deeded back yard. Walking distance (1 block) to Tech shuttle stops. Quick access to 280/101 for South Bay commuters. Centrally located between Church Street, Mission, and Noe's Commercial corridor.
